items.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Mike has toured with Benny Carter

ctx.x: During his career in jazz he has played alongside an impressive list of jazz notables, including Chet Baker, Lee Konitz, Sweets Edison and Benny Golson.

Mike has toured with Benny Carter and accompanied vocalists Sarah Vaughan and Ella Fitzgerald. He was an integral part of Ella’s “All That Jazz” CD, which earned a Grammy nomination in 1991. His wide ranging piano style has been recorded frequently, and can be heard in a solo setting on “Mike Wofford, Live at Maybeck” on Concord Records.
Mike was interviewed in San Diego, California on February 13, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
